config.title: QPi SDK
command.oaiConfig: Configure AI Provider (Base URL / API Key)
config.backend.python: Python interpreter path (defaults to python3; leave empty to auto-detect)
config.backend.autoStart: Automatically start the backend service when VS Code starts
config.backend.mode: local = start the Python backend on this machine; remote = connect to a backend already running on the SDK machine (no local Python needed)
config.backend.remoteUrl: remote mode: backend address, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8765
config.backend.remoteKey: remote mode: backend API key (specified when starting the backend on the SDK machine)
config.backend.pythonMirror: Download mirror prefix for the bundled Python runtime (leave empty to auto-select by network: NJU mirror in China, official GitHub elsewhere; or fill in another mirror prefix)
config.backend.pipMirror: pip dependency mirror (leave empty to auto-select by network: Tsinghua mirror in China, official PyPI elsewhere; or fill in e.g. https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple)
config.download.proxy: Proxy used for all downloads (SDK repos, Python runtime, pip, Docker toolchain, apt). e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:7890. Leave empty to connect directly.
config.download.mirror: Mirror acceleration strategy for downloads (Domestic mirrors go direct even when a proxy is set, so both can be used together)
config.download.mirror.auto: Detect the network region automatically and pick CN or global mirrors
config.download.mirror.cn: Always prefer China mirrors (Tsinghua / USTC / Aliyun / NJU)
config.download.mirror.global: Always prefer official global sources (GitHub / PyPI / download.docker.com)
config.download.mirror.off: Disable mirrors entirely; only use official sources (combine with a proxy if needed)
